title: Doc-link Lint admission accepts any program whose basename is node, including repo-relative paths
outcome: Doc-link Lint admission accepts only the bare node program or an absolute Node executable path, and refuses repo-relative programs such as ./node or tools/node; docs/test.md describes what is actually checked.
acceptance: A recorded focused command whose program is ./node or tools/node with scripts/check-doc-links.mjs is refused for Lint admission, shown by behavioural refusal tests
The bare node program and an absolute Node executable path are still admitted
docs/test.md describes what is actually checked
